critique.evidence: The oversized “Accuracy is the wrong question.” thesis, evaluation-ledger framing, cyan/red defense-lab palette, and constraint-focused labels give the screen a recognizable editorial identity across desktop, tablet, and mobile. However, most of the body resolves into familiar KPI cards, standard charts, a confusion matrix, and an ablation table; the fixed navigation also cuts across the tablet chart, weakening the polished demo moment. The visual idea is strong branding around a largely conventional dashboard, not yet a singular metrics experience.
critique.fix: Create one signature visual that proves the thesis—such as an interactive operating-constraint map linking false-positive caps, recall, money caught, and latency—and make it the dominant centerpiece. Reduce the generic card grid and prevent the navigation from overlaying content at tablet widths.
